authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11366 vartman explicitly lists Gujarati, Marathi and Konkani vāṭ path. It also acknowledges that some feminine forms could equally derive from vartis (11363). Following the primary regional placement, vartman is provisionally selected; the vartis alternative remains unresolved, not disproved. Exact survey form vaṭ is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 700 alagna explicitly lists Hindi/Nepali alag and regional alag/ālag separate. The different responses include transparent distributive repetition alag-alag; both repeated parts continue this same lexeme, not an unrelated second component. Exact survey form alagalag is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
